description:
## Status

Absorbed into `fz-kdt.64`, the bounded consumer-owned `ReturnType`/`ActivationInputs` support cutover.

## Preserved law and evidence

Structural continuation reachability and delivered-value availability are distinct. Temporary absence of a callee `ReturnType` must not erase downstream callsites that do not consume that value, while operations that do consume it remain locally gated. Absence is not the empty type, no `any` placeholder is invented, and a proven-empty return still kills the path.

The focused direct/closure tail-chain regression, current lifecycle counters, and `fz-kdt.106`/abandoned-decommission nontermination evidence transfer to `fz-kdt.64`. That ticket must make the distinction part of the final supported-alternative model before deleting preservation. It must not restore the old live-edge/decommission experiment or weaken telemetry pins.

No standalone implementation remains.
title: Absorbed: separate reachability from absent return evidence
